name: yoinks
description: yoink any video from your terminal. no shady ads.
one_liner: A simple command-line tool that downloads videos from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and 1,800+ other sites directly to your computer — paste a link, pick a quality, done.
buyer: A social media manager or content creator who needs to quickly save reference clips or repurpose their own posted content across platforms.
business_use_cases: A social media manager downloads their own posted videos from TikTok and Instagram to repurpose as YouTube Shorts without screen-recording software.
A video editor at a small agency bulk-pulls reference clips a client points to for storyboard inspiration.
A podcaster extracts audio-only from video interviews using the mp3 mode to publish as a podcast episode.

money_ideas.idea: Wrap it in a simple paid desktop app with a GUI and bulk-download queues for non-technical creators who won't use a terminal.

steal_this: This weekend, build a drag-and-drop desktop wrapper (Electron or Tauri) around it aimed at creators who don't use the command line, and charge a small one-time fee. Note: downloading others' content can violate platform terms of service, so keep the positioning to personal-archiving and your-own-content use cases.
